description.narrative: In the Preparatory Study, we successfully established networks and meaningful relationships with our partner organization, Win Souls for God (WSG), and the girls and young women residing in WSG's Center for former commercial sex workers (the Deborah Center). This study affirmed the strong interest among these young women in participating in a creative project.The project's primary goal is to foster a sustainable and vibrant creative community at the Deborah Center, aimed at strengthening internal bonds. Additionally, we will assist them in creating and hosting Creative Nights - open gatherings that offer sex workers from the streets a chance to experience a supportive community and envision alternative life paths beyond their current circumstances and transition from their past experiences. These activities include knitting, crocheting, and recycling old plastic bags into new shopping bags, empowering them to find new avenues for creativity and self-expression.
